The '''Citadel Guardsmen''' were a group of security [[Agent/Legends|agents]], who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and were based in the [[Citadel Inquisitorius]] on [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]].

==History==
The Guardsmen wore red-and-black colored [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]], making them similar in appearance to the more elite [[Citadel Watchmen]]. However, they were only used for basic security in the citadel. When a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents [[Mission to Prakith (Imperial Period)|infiltrated]] the Citadel, they encountered some Citadel Guardsmen.
